title: Improve Your English Listening & Speaking 🎧 Simple Story: My Weekend

source.translation: Bản dịch tiếng Việt do Lumos thực hiện

cues.en: In this video, we're going to practice English together by listening to a simple and fun story.
Our story today is called 'My Weekend'.
Just follow along, listen closely, try your best, and don't be afraid to repeat after me.
By the end of this lesson, I'm sure you'll feel more confident and see how much you've improved.
LISTEN CAREFULLY Hi! I'm Amy.
I'm excited to share my weekend with you!
My weekend began on Saturday morning.
I woke up early and made myself a cup of hot coffee.
It was the perfect way to start the day!
After breakfast, I went for a jog in the park nearby.
The fresh air and green trees always make me feel refreshed.
Later in the morning, I decided to meet my friend Lucy for brunch at a cozy café.
We ordered pancakes and chatted for hours about our week.
It was so nice to catch up with her!
In the afternoon, I visited a local bookstore.
I love spending time there, exploring new books and getting lost in stories.
I bought a mystery novel that looked exciting!
On Sunday, I spent most of my day at home.
I wanted a quiet day, so I decided to do some baking.
I made chocolate chip cookies, and the whole house smelled amazing!
I also spent time cleaning my room and organizing my closet, which made me feel really productive.
In the evening, I relaxed with a good movie and some popcorn.
It was the perfect way to end my weekend.
I enjoyed every moment, and now I'm ready for a new week!
What about you?
How did you spend your weekend?
Did you try something new or relax at home?
I'd love to hear about your weekend in the comments below!
Let me know your favorite part of the weekend.
Hi, I'm Amy. Now it's time for speaking practice.
Listen carefully and do your best to repeat after me.
Hi! I'm Amy. I'm excited to share my weekend with you!
My weekend began on Saturday morning. I woke up early and made myself a cup of hot coffee.
It was the perfect way to start the day! After breakfast, I went for a jog in the park nearby.
The fresh air and green trees always make me feel refreshed.
Later in the morning, I decided to meet my friend Lucy for brunch at a cozy café.
We ordered pancakes and chatted for hours about our week. It was so nice to catch up with her!
In the afternoon, I visited a local bookstore.
I love spending time there, exploring new books and getting lost in stories.
I bought a mystery novel that looked exciting!
On Sunday, I spent most of my day at home.
I wanted a quiet day, so I decided to do some baking.
I made chocolate chip cookies, and the whole house smelled amazing!
I also spent time cleaning my room and organizing my closet, which made me feel really productive.
In the evening, I relaxed with a good movie and some popcorn.

Jog: A light run. Example: "I like to jog in the morning to stay fit."
Fresh: Cool or clean feeling. Example: "The fresh air feels so nice."
Brunch: A meal between breakfast and lunch. Example: "We had brunch at a new café."
Cozy: Comfortable and warm. Example: "The café was cozy and inviting."
Chat: To talk casually. Example: "I like to chat with friends over coffee."
Exploring: Looking around to discover. Example: "I enjoy exploring new places."
Mystery: Something unknown or a puzzle to solve. Example: "I'm reading a mystery novel."
Baking: Cooking in the oven. Example: "I'm baking cookies for dessert."
Organize: Arrange neatly. Example: "I like to organize my books."
Productive: Getting things done. Example: "A clean room makes me feel productive."
Relax: To rest. Example: "I relax by reading a book."
Popcorn: A snack made from corn kernels. Example: "I eat popcorn during movies."
Routine: Regular way of doing things. Example: "My weekend routine includes exercise and relaxation."
Nearby: Close to a place. Example: "There's a park nearby my house."
Perfect: Just right or ideal. Example: "The weather was perfect for a walk."
"Thanks for listening to Amy's story!
I hope you enjoyed hearing about her weekend and learned some new words.
Remember to leave a comment about how you spent your weekend.
If you enjoyed the story, don't forget to like, share, and subscribe to keep practicing with us!
Also, if you have any suggestions for what themes you'd like to see in future stories,
please leave a comment. I'll see you in the next lesson. Goodbye!"
